_doc: odo's look, for both apps: tools/tokens.py writes it into app/.../ui/Tokens.kt and desktop/tokens.h. Change it here, run the tool, commit all three. Colours are RRGGBB.

packs._doc: Each sound pack's colour: its heading in the sound picker and its sounds' badges (by the pack's name). Any other pack: other.

ghost._doc: A take's ghost fingers over the controller (docs/formats/TAKE_FORMAT.md): each finger down (finger), where it was (trail), where the next goes down (next), the note's name and the words (text, on back). RRGGBBAA. Sizes in dp, times in ms.
